notes.title: Your Average Full Release
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Thank you all so much for the warm reception, as well as all the love! We never anticipated this much attention, but we're happy that all of you love our game as much as we do.

This build for the full release gave us some time to wrap up our major polishing work. This full release doesn't mean that we'll drop the game—we're always receptive of feedback and glad to learn about bugs to tackle, and we still have passion for this game! But consider this our full debut.

Grur Gruff!
